beats.text: Guess: how far out of their league do people message?
You're messaging people out of your league. Everyone is.
Researchers ranked every user of a big dating site by how desirable they were to others.
Most people messaged someone about twenty-five percent more desirable than themselves. Did it work?
Mostly no answer. But about one in five people who aimed up did get a reply. And then there's age.
On that site, men's desirability kept rising until about fifty. Women's fell from eighteen on.
So aim high. Just don't take the silence personally.

sources: Bruch & Newman (2018). Aspirational pursuit of mates in online dating markets. Science Advances 4(8). One dating site, New York, Boston, Chicago, Seattle; desirability via PageRank-like ranking; most users contact partners ~25% more desirable; ~21% of those pursuing out-of-league get a reply; men's desirability rises with age to ~50, women's declines from 18 to 60. Via Phys.org.
